summary: Listens to network traffic and picks out images from TCP streams it observes.
highlights: -b — Beep when a new image is captured.

flags.name: -b
flags.description: Beep when a new image is captured.

flags.name: -f
flags.description: Instead of listening on an interface, read captured packets from a pcap dump file; file can be a named pipe for use with Kismet or similar.

flags.name: -p
flags.description: Do not put the listening interface into promiscuous mode.

flags.name: -a
flags.description: Adjunct mode: do not display images on screen, but save them to a temporary directory and announce their names on standard output.

flags.name: -m
flags.description: Maximum number of images to keep in temporary directory in adjunct mode.

flags.name: -s
flags.description: Attempt to extract streamed audio data from the network, in addition to images. At present this supports MPEG data only.

flags.name: -S
flags.description: Extract streamed audio but not images.

flags.name: -g
flags.description: Enable GTK display (this is the default).

flags.name: -w
flags.description: Enable the HTTP server to display images.

flags.name: -W
flags.description: Port number for the HTTP server (implies -w). Default: 9090.
